title: FIELD COURT — An existing courtyard renewed around four retained trees, 6 deliverables

config.text:
# FIELD COURT

## Site
- Use: community building courtyard; lunch breaks and brief conversations.
- Area: 432 m².
- Boundary: 24 m east–west × 18 m north–south.
- Coordinate origin: southwest corner; x east, y north.
- Southern edge: community building, facade height 6000 mm.
- West, north and east edges: weathered red-brown brick walls, height 1800 mm.
- West and east entrances: y = 0–2 m on each boundary.
- Existing concrete strip: x = 0–24 m, y = 0–2 m.
- Remaining ground: soil and leaf litter.
- Ground datum: east edge 0 mm; west edge +240 mm.
- Ground slope: uniform 1% fall eastwards.
- Ground level formula: z in mm = 240 − 10x, with x in m.
- Detailed geometry records: 03-site-records.en.md.

## Retained fabric
- Existing trees: T1, T2, T3 and T4; Acer campestre.
- Retained tree attributes: coordinates, trunk diameters, crown dimensions and protection circles.
- Protection circle interiors: existing ground levels and leaf litter.
- Retained enclosure: southern building frontage and three brick walls.
- Building frontage: red-brown brick, six evenly spaced rectangular windows, dark painted frames.
- Ground and small facilities outside protection circles: renewal area.

## Names and planting codes
| Item | Fixed text |
|---|---|
| Site | FIELD COURT |
| Circulation zone | Garden Walk |
| Gathering zone | Meeting Pocket |
| P1 | Acer campestre |
| P2 | Geranium macrorrhizum |
| P3 | Luzula sylvatica |

## New elements
- Route: continuous west-to-east entrance connection; clear width 1800 mm.
- Benches: 4; length 1800 mm, depth 500 mm, seat height 450 mm.
- Bench materials: timber slats and galvanised steel frames.
- Wheelchair spaces: 2; each 900 × 1400 mm; each beside a different bench.
- New paving: permeable clay pavers.
- New groundcovers: P2 and P3.
- New work locations: outside all four protection circles.

## Views and section
- A–A: west-to-east section at y = 6 m, through T1 and T2.
- V1: southern entrance to Meeting Pocket; midday and dusk; identical camera position.
- V2: west entrance looking towards the east entrance; daytime.
- Midday use: short seated lunch break.
- Dusk use: informal conversation.

# FIELD COURT — delivery catalog

This table lists every commissioned deliverable with its tier, file format and stage. What each deliverable must contain is stated in the commission letter.

| # | id | Deliverable | Tiers | Format and stage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | courtyard-layout | Final courtyard layout | 6 | Format: PNG, 1800 by 1200 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 2 | protection-seating-details | Tree protection and seating detail sheet | 6 | Format: PNG, 1800 by 1200 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 3 | materials-planting-schedule | Final materials and planting schedule | 6 | Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final. |
| 4 | midday-stay-view | V1 midday stay perspective | 6 | Format: PNG, 1800 by 1200 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 5 | dusk-conversation-view | V1 dusk conversation perspective | 6 | Format: PNG, 1800 by 1200 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 6 | entrance-circulation-view | V2 entrance circulation perspective | 6 | Format: PNG, 1800 by 1200 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |

## Existing section

steps.userMessage:
FIELD COURT | An existing courtyard renewed around four retained trees

Our community building opens onto a courtyard used for lunch breaks and brief conversations between activities. Renew its paths, seating and groundcover around the four existing Acer campestre trees. The site is 24 m east–west by 18 m north–south, an area of 432 m². The building forms the southern edge; weathered brick walls, 1800 mm high, enclose the other three sides. Entrances occupy the southernmost 2 m of both the west and east boundaries. A concrete strip spans the southern 2 m of the courtyard. Ground falls uniformly by 240 mm from west to east, a slope of 1%.

Coordinates start at the southwest corner, with x east and y north. T1 is at (6, 6) m, with trunk diameter 0.40 m and protection radius 2.40 m; T2 at (18, 6) m, diameter 0.45 m and radius 2.70 m; T3 at (6, 13) m, diameter 0.35 m and radius 2.10 m; T4 at (18, 13) m, diameter 0.40 m and radius 2.40 m. Retain these positions, complete protection circles, existing grades and leaf-litter surfaces within the circles. Place every new path, planting bed, pavement edge and bench footing outside them. Organise a continuous route between the entrances with 1800 mm clear width, and a gathering pocket with four benches, each 1800 mm long, 500 mm deep and 450 mm high. Provide a 900 × 1400 mm wheelchair space beside each of two benches. Use permeable clay pavers, timber slats on galvanised steel bench frames, and the groundcovers Geranium macrorrhizum and Luzula sylvatica. Print the site name as "FIELD COURT" and the two zone labels as "Garden Walk" and "Meeting Pocket" on the layout and schedule; repeat all three botanical names there, using P1 for Acer campestre, P2 for Geranium macrorrhizum and P3 for Luzula sylvatica.

Audience: community building users and the facilities team, choosing a courtyard arrangement for short stays, conversation and clear passage between entrances.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md records the site dimensions, retained elements and application names. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists the deliverables, proportions, formats and stages. 03-site-records.en.md contains boundary, entrance, level and individual tree records. courtyard-survey.png locates the fixed boundary, entrances, concrete strip, trunks and protection circles. courtyard-section.png records section A–A through T1 and T2, including ground levels and crown geometry. courtyard-existing.png supplies the courtyard's existing brickwork, building frontage and tree character. midday-pause.png supplies the atmosphere of a short lunchtime stay. evening-conversation.png supplies the atmosphere of informal conversation at dusk.

Deliverables:
1. One final courtyard layout with north arrow, scale bar, dimensions, four numbered trees and protection circles, both entrances, the two named zones, planting codes, four benches, two wheelchair spaces and two viewpoint markers
2. One tree protection and seating detail sheet containing a full-width A–A section through T1 and T2, one enlarged path-edge junction beside a protection circle and one enlarged bench-footing detail
3. One final materials and planting schedule stating the site and zone names, three botanical names and codes, four retained tree records, groundcover quantities and spacing, paving area and build-up, and four benches with their dimensions and materials
4. One midday perspective from viewpoint V1 at the southern entrance to Meeting Pocket, showing seated users and the adjoining Garden Walk
5. One dusk perspective from the same V1 camera position, showing the same arrangement occupied for conversation
6. One daytime circulation perspective from viewpoint V2 at the west entrance, showing the route towards the east entrance and its connection to Meeting Pocket

Acceptance:
- On the courtyard layout, dimension the 24 × 18 m boundary, both 2 m entrance openings and the 1800 mm clear route; label the 432 m² area, north direction, scale bar and 240 mm west-to-east fall. Repeat that fall on the A–A section.
- On the courtyard layout, retain T1–T4 at the stated coordinates with their complete protection radii of 2.40, 2.70, 2.10 and 2.40 m respectively. Repeat their coordinates, trunk diameters and protection radii in the materials and planting schedule; match T1 and T2 to those records on the section and detail sheet.
- On the courtyard layout and detail sheet, place new construction and planting outside all four protection circles and retain the ground profile and leaf litter inside them. Dimension the shortest clearance from each enlarged junction's new work to its adjacent protection boundary.
- On the courtyard layout and materials and planting schedule, print FIELD COURT, Garden Walk, Meeting Pocket and the identical P1–P3 botanical names. Match the schedule's paving area, groundcover quantities and spacing to the layout, and record all four 1800 × 500 × 450 mm benches and both 900 × 1400 mm wheelchair spaces.
- Across the courtyard layout, detail sheet and three perspectives, carry through the same permeable clay paving, timber-and-galvanised-steel benches, four retained trees and two groundcover species. Show the paving build-up and bench footing on the detail sheet using the schedule's materials.
- Mark V1 and V2 with viewing directions on the courtyard layout. Match the midday and dusk V1 perspectives in camera position, tree placement, paving and seating; use the V2 circulation perspective to show the 1800 mm route continuing between the two entrances.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
